prompt_en: A sports photograph of a woman athlete actively practicing a sport. Use the attached image as a face-and-hair visual reference: her facial features follow the attached image, and her dark chin-length bob with fine center-parted bangs follows the attached image. Photograph her at full draw with a recurve bow during a quiet short-distance practice session at an outdoor archery range. The held breath before release is the moment: her gaze follows the arrow toward a circular target on a straw backstop downrange, while the tip of a small wind ribbon beside the lane lifts in the afternoon breeze. Her left arm reaches toward the target with the left palm bearing on the bow's central grip, and the bow riser stands vertically. The right elbow extends backward at shoulder height; her right fingers hook the taut string with a leather finger tab, and the draw hand anchors beneath her jaw. A single arrow rests on the arrow rest through the bow window, its nock connected to the string beside the drawing fingers. The bent upper and lower recurve limbs and the two taut string segments from their tips to the arrow nock form one connected mechanism. Her feet stand apart on the grass behind the shooting line, both shoe soles meeting the ground, with her torso balanced over them. She wears a fitted ivory sleeveless training top, forest-green athletic trousers, flat training shoes and a slim forearm guard on the extended left arm. The restrained attraction lies in her concentrated eyes, relaxed lips and the assured line of the shoulders, supported by softly lit skin and natural hair texture. Use a wide horizontal, full-body composition with generous space around both shoes and both bow tips; the camera sees her from the drawing-hand side at a slight frontal oblique, keeping the face, drawing fingertips, arrow nock, bow-hand contact and complete string route individually readable together. The nearby target remains a secondary visible destination in the left depth of the image. Late afternoon side light gives the bowstring a fine bright edge against a shaded green background. A natural 50 mm photographic perspective and a moderately deep focus keep the athlete and working equipment sharp, letting the farther lane soften. Make the image feel like a quiet, closely observed practice moment whose tension comes from a real held load rather than a performance for the camera.
